Screen_or_Command: TUI Find a Model -> Setup Modal
Expected_Behavior: Show active progress bar with downloaded MB/total MB and phase indicator
Actual_Behavior: Shows only initial transient toast notification then screen appears static while downloading multi-gigabyte models
User_Impact: Nontechnical user assumes application froze or crashed and terminates process early
Suggested_Correction: Implement a persistent Setup Progress Modal or progress gauge widget in TUI with percent and byte counters

Expected_Behavior: Seamless transition or prompt to chat with model upon setup completion
Actual_Behavior: TUI has no chat tab or dialog instructing user how to start chatting; user remains on Installed list
User_Impact: Beginner completes setup but cannot figure out how to converse with the model
Suggested_Correction: Add a chat transition dialog or integrated TUI chat screen with a direct shortcut to chat

Expected_Behavior: Allow stopping model by model name or installation ID
Actual_Behavior: Requires exact ephemeral instance ID (inst_run_...); fails if given model name
User_Impact: User cannot stop model without first querying localpilot running and copy-pasting internal instance IDs
Suggested_Correction: Allow localpilot stop to resolve target by model_id or installation_id as localpilot chat does

Expected_Behavior: Plain language explanation of engine and hardware mode
Actual_Behavior: Renders raw Python Enum strings (e.g. InferenceBackend.LLAMACPP and ExecutionMode.AUTO)
User_Impact: Confusing internal code representation shown to beginners
Suggested_Correction: Format enums as human-friendly text: 'llama.cpp (Local Engine)' and 'Automatic (Best hardware)'

Expected_Behavior: Recommend direct chat command upon successful setup
Actual_Behavior: Recommends 'localpilot run <inst_id>' which only starts background daemon without opening chat
User_Impact: User runs daemon and is left at shell prompt with endpoint URL rather than interactive chat
Suggested_Correction: Change post-setup recommendation to 'To start chatting: localpilot chat <name>'

Expected_Behavior: Format runtime names in human list
Actual_Behavior: Prints raw Python list literal representation (Discovered Runtimes: ['llamacpp'])
User_Impact: Unpolished appearance and minor confusion for non-developers
Suggested_Correction: Format runtime list as comma-separated names or 'llama.cpp'

Screen_or_Command: CLI storage vs TUI Storage tab
Actual_Behavior: CLI uses 'Model Files' and 'Downloads & Temporary' while TUI uses 'Model Weights' and 'Downloads & Temp'
User_Impact: Slight inconsistency when following cross-interface documentation
Suggested_Correction: Standardize category titles across both CLI Table and TUI Label

Expected_Behavior: Clarify why safe RAM budget is lower than free RAM
Actual_Behavior: Displays '8.9GB RAM free (Safe: 4.3GB)' without explaining why safe budget is reduced
User_Impact: Users assume an 8GB model should run on 8.9GB free RAM and don't understand incompatibility flag
Suggested_Correction: Add brief hint: 'Safe budget reserves memory for your OS and conversation context'

Expected_Behavior: Explain context length column in plain terms
Actual_Behavior: Table displays raw integer context tokens (e.g. 8192 or 32768) without units or meaning
User_Impact: Beginners do not understand what 8192 means or how it impacts conversation memory
Suggested_Correction: Header or tooltip should label as 'Memory/Context (tokens)' with a brief guide note

Actual_Behavior: Shows launcher path and PATH tip
User_Impact: If user's PATH does not contain ~/.local/bin user might type localpilot and receive command not found
Suggested_Correction: Add prominent tip testing ~/.local/bin in PATH and instructing to run ~/.local/bin/localpilot directly if missing
